name: NoN Addon
description: Adds an andesite alloy recipe (2 iron ingots + 2 liquid bottles -> 9 andesite alloy), makes the horse liquid collector emit a redstone pulse in a 3x3 area once its animation has finished, and lets automation (Create's Deployer) take the liquid bottle out of a full collector. It also adds the nonaddon:animation_speed status effect: while a player taking part in a NoN animation has it, that animation plays 1.5x / 2x / 2.5x faster at level 1 / 2 / 3.
